description.value: The Best Western Cowichan Valley Inn is a full-service hotel in Duncan on Vancouver Island, positioned along the Cowichan Valley corridor as the area's flagship Best Western property. The on-site CVI Restaurant and Lounge provides sit-down dining, making it a convenient stop after a day of riding. As a well-established branded hotel it draws repeat visitors to the region north of Victoria.

address.value: 6457 Norcross Road, Duncan, British Columbia V9L 6C6 Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, operating Best Western hotel in Duncan, BC with an on-site restaurant (CVI Restaurant and Lounge explicitly named in the hotel overview text). The amenity strings appearing at the top of each page ('free-breakfast free-high-speed-internet accessible-room' etc.) also appear verbatim on unrelated global pages (customer service, affiliate program), confirming they are site-wide navigation/filter elements rather than property-specific verified amenities, so all are treated as null. A material address discrepancy exists: OSM lists '6474 Trans-Canada Highway' while the hotel's own booking page lists '6457 Norcross Road, Duncan, British Columbia V9L 6C6 Canada'; the website value is used per rule 12.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '6474 Trans-Canada Highway' but the hotel's Best Western booking page lists '6457 Norcross Road, Duncan, British Columbia V9L 6C6 Canada'. Website address used as primary source; OSM record may need correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating branded hotel in Duncan, BC, publicly accessible and a practical accommodation option for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site CVI Restaurant and Lounge described in hotel overview as offering 'some of the finest eating experiences in the Cowichan Valley'
